'''Assimilated Villagers''', known internally as '''Infvillager''', are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Villagers.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawned when a Villager succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25, once 6 villagers have been assimilated.
* Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by level 3 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Capabilities'' ==
Assimilated Villagers are Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, with a 20% chance to inflict [[Bleeding]] for 3 seconds.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Villager will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive]]. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Villagers are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Villagers are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* If an Assimilated Villager gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref>, it will evolve into a Moving Flesh.
* If an Assimilated Villager gets 60 kills and is unable to turn into [[Moving Flesh]], it will evolve into a [[Feral Villager]].
* If an Assimilated Villager kills 5 Skeletons and is unable to turn into [[Moving Flesh]], it will evolve into a [[Host]].
* On death, Assimilated Villagers have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]], 2 Buglins, and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive]].
** When not exploding, there is a 50% chance an Assimilated Villager will drop its [[Walking Villager Head|Head]].
